adreno-7xx.notes: Adreno 7xx (Galaxy S23, Adreno 740): the pinned Turnip with D3D11 through DXVK. In WoW Forever on the S23, D3D11 needed about 20% fewer GPU cycles per frame than D3D12 through vkd3d-proton, so the thermally limited GPU draws more frames.

adreno-6xx.notes: Adreno 6xx: same driver choice as before device rules existed, with D3D11 through DXVK since rules v9 like the Adreno 7xx. No 6xx phone has been tested.

adreno-8xx.notes: Adreno 800-839 (Gen 8 below the 840: 810, 825, 829, 830; Snapdragon 8 Elite, 8s Gen 4): the Adreno 840 setup (V32-RP6sched, then Gen 8 V37, with D3D11), then the pinned Turnip and the system driver. D3D12 is disabled because Battle.net's Play starts WoW without -d3d11 and WoW keeps its saved GxApi; without d3d12.dll it falls back to D3D11. A Lenovo tablet with an Adreno 825 drew incorrectly on the pinned Turnip with D3D12 (issue #17). Not yet run on an Adreno 8xx phone.

adreno-84x.notes: Adreno 840 (Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5): the system driver with D3D11. On a OnePlus 15 (issue #13, chip 0x44050A31) every offered Turnip build drew glitches in WoW Retail, also with D3D11 (turnip-gamehub-v26.0.0-r8-b12 crashed at character select instead), while qualcomm-842.6 played in-world with some frame drops and the reporter called the system driver the best way to play. The Turnip builds stay in the picker: V32-RP6sched with D3D11 is the setup of the only other reported in-world run on an 840 (WoW Forever on a RedMagic 11 Pro). D3D12 is disabled because Battle.net's Play starts WoW without -d3d11 and WoW keeps its saved GxApi; without d3d12.dll it falls back to D3D11 (verified on the Galaxy S23).

adreno-other.notes: Any other Adreno: same driver choice as before device rules existed, with D3D11 through DXVK since rules v9.

mali.notes: Mali and Immortalis (Pixel 8a, Mali-G715): the system driver with the BCn compat layer and D3D11 through DXVK. D3D12 through vkd3d-proton fails on the Pixel 8a.

non-adreno-other.notes: Xclipse, PowerVR and other non-Adreno GPUs: the system driver with the BCn compat layer, as before device rules existed, with D3D11 through DXVK since rules v9.

unknown-gpu.notes: No GL renderer string: treated as a possible Adreno like before device rules existed, with D3D11 through DXVK since rules v9.

rules.source: KGSL chip id 0x44050Axx (the OnePlus 15 and Galaxy S26 Ultra report 0x44050A31; 0x44050A21 was seen on a POCO F9 Pro); works when the renderer string has no model
GL renderer reports an Adreno 800-839 (Gen 8 below the 840)
